title: AWO Initiation Artifact
description: Declares the existence of an intentional unit of work. Captures intent, high-level scope boundary, initiating actor, and AI assistance disclosure without asserting legitimacy, correctness, or authority.

type.description: Replaces 'artifact_type' to align with ARI Metadata Policy.

version.description: Replaces 'awo_version' to align with ARI Metadata Policy (SemVer).

status.description: REQUIRED by Invariant I-2. Defines if the initiation is live or merely proposed.

created.description: Replaces 'created_at' to align with standard YAML metadata keys.

is_root.description: Indicates this artifact is the root of an AWO workflow.

mutable.description: Initiation artifacts are immutable once created.

actors.description: Actors initiating the unit of work.

ai_assisted.description: TRUE indicates AI assistance was used in forming intent.

intent.description: Free-text declaration of the intended work or inquiry.

scope_boundary.description: High-level declaration of what this work is and is not intended to cover.

notes.description: Optional contextual notes or constraints declared at initiation time.
